text: Mouwasat Medical Services Company (Tadawul: 4002): its largest shareholder is top key executive Mohammed Al-Saleem with 18% of shares outstanding; the second and third largest are Nasser Sultan Al-Subaie and Mohammed Al-Subaie, around 18% each, for a combined 53%.
short: Mouwasat's main shareholders are company insiders (about 53% combined)

source.name: Simply Wall St: What Type Of Shareholder Owns Mouwasat Medical Services Company's (TADAWUL:4002)?
source.quote: its Top Key Executive, Mohammed Al-Saleem, is the largest shareholder, holding 18% of shares outstanding
source.note: Same article: 'The second and third largest shareholders are Nasser Sultan Al-Subaie and Mohammed Al-Subaie, each holding around 18% of the shares outstanding' and 'the top 3 shareholders have a combined ownership of 53% in the company'; institutions 6.0%, general public 41%. Figures as of May 2020.
